requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C1 - adjudication this request is about
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C1 - adjudication this request is about
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no adjudication fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the court, case number and date of the juvenile adjudication, copied from the record

requiredBeforeFiling.why: the category is a fact of the participant's own record and the platform holds no value for it
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the eligibility category you believe applies, in your own words

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C3 - how the record was checked
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C3 - how the record was checked
requiredBeforeFiling.why: only the participant knows when and how they checked
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date you checked and what you looked at

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Item C4 - what is being asked of the office
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Item C4 - what is being asked of the office
requiredBeforeFiling.why: the platform never writes a participant's own request for them
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: what you are asking the office to do, in your own words

protectedBlanks.label: Signature of the person named in the caption, on the request
protectedBlanks.why: the participant signs personally; this build never signs for anyone

protectedBlanks.label: Date beside the signature on the request
protectedBlanks.why: a date written before the document is signed would be false
